claims.claim: You can apply or do this online.
claims.quote: The quickest way to register is online.
claims.note: The subcontractor page says you can register online.

claims.claim: You can apply or do this by phone.
claims.note: The pages give helplines for getting help and reporting changes, and offer registration online or by post, but never say you can register by phone.

claims.claim: CIS registration requires HMRC registration as a business with a UTR.
claims.quote: To use the online service, you need a UTR . If you do not have a UTR , register as a new business for Self Assessment
claims.note: The page says you need a UTR and, if you do not have one, must register as a new business first.

claims.claim: Limited companies also need Companies House registration.
claims.quote: Depending on your circumstances, you may also need: the company registration number
claims.note: The page says a limited company may need its company registration number, but it does not say Companies House registration is a requirement for CIS.

claims.quote: the Unique Taxpayer Reference ( UTR ) for your business
claims.note: The page lists the business UTR as something you need to register for CIS.

claims.claim: A limited company needs its Companies House registration number.
claims.quote: Depending on your circumstances, you may also need: the company registration number
claims.note: The limited company registration page lists the company registration number as something you may need.

claims.claim: You need to provide details of the nature of your construction work.
claims.note: None of the registration lists of what you need asks for a description of the construction work.
